title: Director Undergraduate Enrollment Marketing
description:
Position Overview

The Undergraduate Enrollment Marketing Director provides strategic
leadership for Butler’s undergraduate enrollment marketing efforts,
developing and executing integrated marketing and communication
strategies that support institutional recruitment goals. This role
leads enrollment marketing efforts for all undergraduate audiences,
including traditional residential first-year, transfer, and
international students, as well as emerging education models such
as Founder’s College and Butler Overseas. The Director supervises
undergraduate enrollment marketing staff and works in close
partnership with Enrollment Management while leading
cross-functional collaboration across University Marketing to
translate enrollment priorities into coordinated, high-quality
execution.

Responsibilities

Direct the development of integrated enrollment marketing and
communication strategies across print, email, digital, social, and
web channels for all undergraduate audiences, including traditional
residential first-year, transfer, and international students, as
well as new education models such as Founder’s College and Butler
Overseas. Develop and execute targeted marketing strategies for key
influencer audiences—including parents and families, school
counselors, and educators—to strengthen visibility with prospective
students.

Lead day-to-day undergraduate enrollment marketing operations,
setting priorities and serving as the primary point of contact for
campus partners. Translate enrollment priorities into integrated
marketing strategies and lead cross-functional University Marketing
teams through a matrix model to deliver them. Supervise
undergraduate enrollment marketing staff, manage the Admission
communications budget, and oversee external vendors.

Support Admission and Financial Aid recruitment
efforts—including student search, application generation, visits
and events, travel, decision release, yield, and financial aid
packaging—by developing and managing effective enrollment marketing
and communication strategies.

Develop and lead enrollment marketing strategies to bring new
and emerging educational models to market (e.g., Butler Overseas,
Founder’s College), establishing scalable go-to-market frameworks
that support growth.

Collaborate with Enrollment Management and campus partners to
inform and enhance campus visit and event programming, contributing
enrollment marketing strategy, audience perspective, and brand and
messaging guidance to strengthen the overall prospective student
experience.

Partner with Enrollment Management on undergraduate market
growth and student search strategy, managing lead generation
vendors and communications and leading ongoing evaluation of tools,
lead sources, and marketing partners.

Lead communication strategy for incoming student processes and
key onboarding milestones (e.g., Housing, New Student Registration,
Orientation), partnering with campus units to deliver a cohesive
transition from admission through matriculation.


Required Qualifications

7–10 years of relevant experience in an enrollment marketing,
higher education marketing, or enrollment
management/admission/recruitment role.

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, or a related
field.

Strong understanding of the enrollment landscape, trends, and
business processes; fluency in enrollment data and prospective
student lifecycles.

Strong proficiency with CRM (Slate) and marketing automation
platforms, with the ability to translate enrollment strategy into
audience segmentation, communication journeys, campaign workflows,
personalization, and performance measurement.

Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to
adapt messaging to resonate with high school–aged students and
their influencers.

Proven success in marketing competencies, including strategic
marketing plan development, print media and direct mail,
CRM/marketing automation, email marketing, and advertising.

Strong project and workflow management skills, with the ability
to prioritize and execute multiple high-impact initiatives
simultaneously while aligning teams and stakeholders around shared
goals.

Ability to interpret campaign performance insights and use data
to inform decision-making and continuous improvement.

Demonstrated skill in building relationships and working
effectively with cross-functional partners across a complex
organization.

Ability to lead teams, supervise staff, and lead strategy
across multiple departments.


Preferred Qualifications

Prior budget management experience

Proficiency in Slate CRM or related CRM platform

About Us

Butler University is a private, nationally recognized comprehensive
university encompassing seven colleges: Arts, Business,
Communication, Education, Liberal Arts & Sciences, Pharmacy
& Health Sciences and Founder's College. Approximately 4,500
undergraduate and 1,000 graduate and doctoral students are enrolled
at Butler, representing 46 states and 24 countries.

Join us at the crossroads of tradition & transformation. A
career at Butler University offers more than just a job—it’s an
opportunity to join a dedicated, innovative, and supportive
community grounded in equity, academic excellence, and meaningful
impact. Aligned with Boldly Butler, our strategic plan, faculty and
staff play a vital role in delivering transformational learning
experiences, enriching our campus and community, and ensuring a
thriving Butler for generations to come.

Butler University is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome
applications from all individuals, regardless of age, sex, race,
religion, color, disability, protected veteran status, national
origin, or any other legally protected category.
